summary.one_liner: TypeScript SDKs (React, Admin, and Client) for Proficient AI, a platform for adding LLM-powered conversational AI agents to apps.
summary.what_it_does: The repository holds the source code for Proficient's TypeScript SDKs. According to the README, these include a React SDK, an Admin SDK, and a Client SDK. The README describes Proficient as a platform with interaction APIs, SDKs, and a web dashboard for adding and operating LLM-powered agents in end-user applications. The README gives no code examples, install commands, or API details. It links to external documentation and a Discord community.
use_cases: add a conversational AI agent to a web app
build a React chat interface for an LLM agent
manage AI agents through an admin SDK
integrate LLM-powered agents into end-user applications
use a TypeScript client SDK for conversational AI
notable: Covers React, Admin, and Client SDKs in one TypeScript repository
Pairs the SDKs with a web dashboard for operating agents
Targets LLM-powered conversational agents for end-user apps
Links to external docs and a Discord community
caveats: Currently in private beta; the README asks users to reach out for early access
The README includes no setup or run instructions
Platform access depends on the hosted Proficient service
